name: GPTarot

cards.name: The Fool
cards.essence: The Fool is the image of possibility before it becomes a plan.
cards.past: You followed a feeling before you could explain it. That was not foolish; it was the only honest beginning available.
cards.present: The picture is open. Take the next small step and let the path answer you.
cards.future: A new image is approaching fast. Keep your hands light enough to receive it.
cards.question: Where could you let curiosity lead for one day?

cards.name: The Magician
cards.essence: The Magician turns attention into an instrument.
cards.past: You had more influence than you admitted, and the image shows where you used it.
cards.present: Choose one thing and make it vivid. Your attention is the spell in this room.
cards.future: A chance to shape the scene is coming. Be precise rather than impressive.
cards.question: What are you ready to make real?

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.essence: The High Priestess is the meaning that appears when the noise stops.
cards.past: You noticed the hidden current before anyone else did. Do not edit that perception to make it easier to share.
cards.present: Stay behind the first answer. The quieter signal is the one worth following.
cards.future: A secret becomes legible when you stop chasing it. Let the veil thin in its own time.
cards.question: What are you sensing beneath the obvious story?

cards.name: The Empress
cards.essence: The Empress is the image of life making more life.
cards.past: Something generous gave you room to become. Remember the feeling, not just the source.
cards.present: Put care where you want abundance. Small acts of tending have a long shadow.
cards.future: What you have been nurturing is close to becoming visible. Receive it without rushing it.
cards.question: What deserves more of your attention and tenderness?

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.essence: The Emperor is a clear edge around what matters.
cards.past: A rule or authority shaped this chapter. Keep the protection; question the fear beneath it.
cards.present: Make the boundary kind and unmistakable. Structure is here to free the living thing inside it.
cards.future: You will need to hold your ground soon. Let firmness speak before force does.
cards.question: Which boundary would make you more available to life?

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.essence: The Hierophant is a door into a practice shared with others.
cards.past: An inherited ritual helped you name what mattered. Keep its wisdom, not its costume.
cards.present: Borrow a structure that supports you. You do not have to invent every answer alone.
cards.future: A guide or community appears. Notice whether belonging makes your world larger.
cards.question: What practice helps you remember who you are?

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.essence: The Lovers is the image of a choice made with the whole self.
cards.past: A past yes still lives in the room. Feel what it opened, and what it closed.
cards.present: Two honest desires are asking to be seen together. Choose by alignment, not by noise.
cards.future: A meeting or decision brings the heart into focus. Do not offer a partial truth.
cards.question: What would a full-bodied yes feel like?

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.essence: The Chariot is motion held steady by a living center.
cards.past: You moved through competing pulls by staying close to your destination.
cards.present: Keep both opposing feelings in view, then choose the direction that can carry them.
cards.future: Momentum builds. Speed is less important than knowing which way you are facing.
cards.question: What is steering you when you are not paying attention?

cards.name: Strength
cards.essence: Strength is the image of power that does not need to dominate.
cards.past: You softened a difficult force without abandoning yourself. That quiet skill remains yours.
cards.present: Meet the fierce part gently. It may be protecting the very thing you need to hear.
cards.future: A charged moment can become intimacy if you stay present instead of performing control.
cards.question: What would your strength look like without armour?

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.essence: The Hermit is a small light trusted in a large dark.
cards.past: Distance let a real question rise above the crowd. You were right to make that space.
cards.present: Withdraw just enough to hear your own pattern. The answer does not need an audience yet.
cards.future: A quiet guide or a quiet season gives you the missing angle. Go toward the stillness.
cards.question: What becomes visible only when you stop explaining yourself?

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.essence: The Wheel is the image of a pattern changing its face.
cards.past: A turn of circumstance carried you farther than effort could. Let luck have its share of the story.
cards.present: You are between states. Watch the rhythm and place yourself where the next turn can meet you.
cards.future: The scene changes quickly. Flexibility will serve you better than a perfect prediction.
cards.question: What pattern is asking to be met differently this time?

cards.name: Justice
cards.essence: Justice is the image that makes the picture honest.
cards.past: A past choice still has weight. You can acknowledge its cost without becoming its prisoner.
cards.present: Look straight at the exchange. Give each fact its proper size, including your own needs.
cards.future: A clear consequence or decision is near. Let accuracy be a form of care.
cards.question: What becomes fair when you include yourself?

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.essence: The Hanged Man is the image that changes when you stop insisting on the old angle.
cards.past: A pause rearranged your priorities. The delay was not empty time.
cards.present: Release the need to force the next frame. Let the upside-down view teach you something.
cards.future: A suspended interval reveals what urgency kept hidden. Do less, but see more.
cards.question: Which struggle would loosen if you stopped pulling?

cards.name: Death
cards.essence: Death is the image of a door closing so the room can change.
cards.past: An ending made the present possible. Honour the loss without reopening the door.
cards.present: Let the old form finish. Change is already moving through the empty space.
cards.future: A clean release brings new color. Do not carry yesterday's costume into it.
cards.question: What is ready to be finished with love?

cards.name: Temperance
cards.essence: Temperance is the image of two currents learning one rhythm.
cards.past: You found a workable middle by listening to both extremes.
cards.present: Adjust the mixture. The right balance is alive, not a rule you set once.
cards.future: Two different needs can cooperate soon. Move slowly enough to notice the blend.
cards.question: What could become possible if you changed the proportions?

cards.name: The Devil
cards.essence: The Devil is the image of a bond that wants to be seen clearly.
cards.past: A desire became a habit, then a story about who you had to be.
cards.present: Look at the chain without shame. Naming the appetite gives you room to choose.
cards.future: A tempting shortcut arrives. Ask whether it feeds you or only keeps the loop alive.
cards.question: What are you loyal to because it is familiar?

cards.name: The Tower
cards.essence: The Tower is the image that removes what could not remain.
cards.past: A rupture exposed the weak beam. The surprise was painful, but the truth was useful.
cards.present: Do not rush to repair the picture. See what the collapse has made visible.
cards.future: A sudden opening breaks the old arrangement. Keep what is alive and let the rest fall.
cards.question: What truth would make rebuilding unnecessary?

cards.name: The Star
cards.essence: The Star is the image of trust returned to the body.
cards.past: Hope came back in a small form. You did not need to believe everything to begin healing.
cards.present: Let yourself be visible without a shield. The future can meet an undefended heart.
cards.future: A clean horizon appears. Follow what restores your sense of possibility.
cards.question: What would you ask for if hope were safe?

cards.name: The Moon
cards.essence: The Moon is the image that makes uncertainty feel alive.
cards.past: Fear filled in missing details and called them facts. You can redraw the picture now.
cards.present: Move by small signals. Not every shadow needs to become a conclusion tonight.
cards.future: A dream or doubt reveals a hidden route. Stay curious while the image shifts.
cards.question: What are you assuming because the light is low?

cards.name: The Sun
cards.essence: The Sun is the image that lets nothing hide from warmth.
cards.past: A clear and joyful moment showed you how simple truth can feel.
cards.present: Let the good thing be good. You do not need to earn the light by distrusting it.
cards.future: Confidence and warmth gather around you. Share them without turning them into a performance.
cards.question: Where is life already saying yes?

cards.name: Judgement
cards.essence: Judgement is the image that asks the sleeping self to stand up.
cards.past: An old version of you ended when you answered a call you could not unhear.
cards.present: Listen for the invitation beneath the pressure. This is a return to what is most alive.
cards.future: A second chance arrives with a clearer name. Answer as the person you are now.
cards.question: What part of you is ready to come back?

cards.name: The World
cards.essence: The World is the image of separate threads becoming one field.
cards.past: A cycle closed and left you with more of yourself than you began with.
cards.present: Finish the last visible piece. Let completion be a felt state, not another task.
cards.future: A larger horizon opens after the circle closes. Carry the lesson, not the burden.
cards.question: What would completion make room for?

pairs: The Fool and the World make one image of beginning and completion. You may be closer to a new cycle than you think.
The Magician and the High Priestess pair action with perception. Make room for both the hand and the hidden signal.
The Empress and the Emperor ask growth to meet structure. Give the living thing a container, not a cage.
The Hierophant and the Hermit show two ways to learn: through belonging and through solitude. Let each correct the other.
The Lovers becoming the Chariot: a choice gains direction. Decide, then let movement teach you what the choice means.
The Chariot meets Strength. Momentum becomes presence; steer with warmth, not with clenched hands.
Strength beside the Devil puts instinct in the light. Desire is not the enemy, but it should not hold the reins.
The Wheel turning into the Tower is a fast change of frame. Let the surprise clear the image instead of defining you.
Justice into the Hanged Man: after seeing clearly, release the urge to act immediately.
The Hanged Man and Death turn pause into release. The thing you stop forcing may finally be allowed to end.
Death opening into the Star is the quiet promise after a clean ending. Protect the new light.
Temperance and the Devil ask what kind of pleasure can last. Change the measure, not the aliveness.
The Tower followed by the Star: the image breaks, then breath returns. Do not rebuild the old picture.
The Star entering the Moon keeps hope alive inside uncertainty. Trust the small light, not the whole map.
The Moon becoming the Sun is a fog lifting. Let clarity arrive through experience, not argument.
The Sun and Judgement turn joy into a calling. What feels good may also be asking to become useful.
Judgement opening into the World gives the call a place to land. Answer by completing something real.
The High Priestess and the Moon share a deep-water language. Notice what the dream knows before you translate it.
The Emperor and the Tower reveal the difference between structure and rigidity. Keep only what can flex and stand.
The Lovers and the Devil make attachment visible. A bond can be intimate without becoming a chain.
The Hermit and the Wheel: solitude changes the way you recognize the next turn.
Temperance and the World show integration as a lived practice. Wholeness is assembled in daily proportions.
